    CRV price performance

    Over the past year, Curve DAO has fallen 51.0%. Its daily closes ranged from $0.1789 (November 21, 2026) to $0.4411 (November 26, 2025) over the last 52 weeks. On November 22, 2026 it closed at $0.1819, 58.8% below that high, with 30-day annualized volatility of 78%. Its best full month was Aug 2026 (+62.22%) and its worst was Oct 2026 (-28.05%). Over the last 90 days its daily moves had a correlation of 0.58 with Bitcoin's (loosely tied; 1 would mean moving in lockstep). Its largest fall between daily closes within the year was 59.4%, from November 26, 2025 to November 21, 2026. Over one year it ranked 16th of the 23 DeFi & real-world assets coins tracked here with a full year of data.

    About Curve DAO

    Curve is a decentralized exchange optimized for low-slippage swaps between similar assets such as stablecoins. Vote-locked CRV directs liquidity rewards and earns fees.

    Where this CRV price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (CRV-USD), Binance (CRV/USDT) and Kraken (CRV/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.39B CRV (supply last updated November 23, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
